proposals.evidence: Turner documents the kuṭhāra axe family with Prakrit kuḍhāra/kuhāḍa and explicitly discusses the ṭh–r versus h–ḍ metathesis. Comparanda include Punjabi kuhāṛā/kuhāṛī, Bengali kuṛul, Oriya kurhāṛi/kuṛāri, Gujarati kuvāṛī, Marathi kurhāḍ and Kotgarhi kəṛari. These survey forms preserve those regional axe stems, including masculine/feminine pairs and local initial voicing or reduced vowels; the family link does not assert a regular sound law for every local variant. Other axe names and extended or uncertain responses are excluded.
